versions.changelog:
Initial release of Layoff Deadline Tracker.

- Extracts critical post-layoff deadlines from severance/layoff documents (COBRA, 401(k) loan, equity, unemployment, final pay, ADEA timelines)
- Computes and outputs a personalized deadline map with key expiration dates
- Provides severance vs. notice pay calculations and highlights WARN Act 60-day rules for group layoffs
- Generates checklist for unemployment filing and all benefits elections ordered by urgency
- Includes detailed CLI usage and best-practices guide for common layoff scenarios
